content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH — Network/RDMA errors observed in serving-cluster-r2 and serving-cluster-r3. Symptoms: packet loss, IB link flaps, multiple container restarts (OOM/CUDA errors reported after retries). Affected route: /v1/generate (multi-tenant). Customers flagged: ACME-payments (sev1), SearchCo (sev2). Pager: 1769004321
sara (oncall): I'm on it. Can someone grab logs from r2 nodes?
raj (infra): Pulling `dmesg` and `ibstat` now, also checking fabric switches with netops.
raj (infra): `ssh node-r2-05` -> `dmesg | tail -n 40` shows:
```
[ 1234.567890] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: NIC Link is Down
[ 1234.568000] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: Async event: PF link down
[ 1234.569000] ib_smi1: link down on port 1
```
raj (infra): `ibstat` on node-r2-05: port 1 state: Down, phys state: Polling
mel (sre): Are we seeing retransmits/packet loss counters spike?
raj (infra): Yes, `perfquery` shows tx_dropped increasing. Netops slacked: @netops-team this looks like fabric flaps, could be cable or switch port.
infra-bot: Ticket created: NET-7893, assigned to netops-oncall.
liam (eng-runtime): We're seeing a cascade: when IB goes down, the serving runtime retries, then multiple CUDA contexts allocate leading to OOMs on other nodes when failover triggers. Logs show repeated `CUDA: out of memory` and container crashloopbackoff.
liam (eng-runtime): Sample from pod serving-abc-7: `E tensorflow: ResourceExhaustedError: OOM when allocating tensor with shape [1,2048]` then container `OOMKilled`.
sara (oncall): Initial mitigation: can we toggle smart-routing to avoid r2/r3 while netops investigates? Need fast customer relief.
liam (eng-runtime): Yes, we have a routing policy `fabric-pref` — I can add rule to avoid clusters r2,r3 and route to r1 and dedicated-fallback region. Doing it now.
liam (eng-runtime): `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/update -d '{"avoid_clusters":["r2","r3"]}'` -> 200 OK. Rolling out in 30s.
mel (sre): Confirming traffic shift: metrics show 93% of /v1/generate routed to r1 within 45s; p95 latency rose ~30% for some queries but error rate dropped immediately. :thumbsup:
sara (oncall): Notifying impacted customers. @ellie can you message ACME-payments and SearchCo with ETA and mitigation steps?
ellie (cs): On it — I'll ping ACME and mention fallback to r1 and that we're prioritizing their traffic.
raj (infra): Netops reports switch port flapping on leaf-12. They reseated SFP and are running diagnostics. Might be bad optics causing IB link down.
infra-bot: Netops update (1769004680): leaf-12 SFP reseated; error counters decreasing but still intermittent.
liam (eng-runtime): FYI we still see a handful of pods in CrashLoopBackOff that were restarted during the flap. Recommended: `kubectl rollout restart` for serving-deployment v2 to clear leaked CUDA contexts.
mel (sre): I'll kick the rollout on non-prod first then prod canary. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-deployment -n serving`
mel (sre): Canary restart done on node r1-cand, metrics stable. Scheduling rolling restart across remaining replicas with maxUnavailable=1.
sara (oncall): Handoff time coming up in 18m. Mel — can you take oncall for the remainder and lead the post-incident? I'll add Maria as postmortem owner.
mel (sre): I can take it. Sara — leave any running commands in thread before you go.
sara (oncall): Noted. Things left: 1) Monitor netops ticket for final confirmation, 2) Verify no residual customer errors after routing change, 3) Ensure restart rollout completes. Maria owns postmortem.
maria (postmortem): I'll start the incident doc template and pull logs. Will need timeline and decision points.
liam (eng-runtime): Adding note: we should add a guard to limit concurrent CUDA context allocations on failover to avoid OOM cascade (throttle concurrent restarts). Filing ENG-4567.
raj (infra): Netops: leaf-12 still reports occasional link-downs but at much lower rate. They requested we keep traffic away from r2/r3 for 1 hour while they replace the SFP tomorrow.
mel (sre): Routing rule extended for 1h. `fabric-pref` updated with `avoid_until=1769009430`
ellie (cs): ACME acknowledged, they saw errors drop after ~2m. They want a postmortem and timeline for 24h SLA.
maria (postmortem): Assigned. I'll loop in legal/compliance for customer comms.
sara (oncall): I'm handing off now — mel takes over. Good job team. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mel (sre): Taking over oncall. Monitoring. Please escalate to me if anything spikes.
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (routing fallback applied). Severity lowered to SEV2 pending netops confirmation.
mel (sre): Next steps captured: 1) Netops to replace SFP and confirm stable link, 2) Eng-runtime to implement CUDA restart throttle / circuit-breaker, 3) Postmortem (maria) in 24hrs with root cause and action items.
raj (infra): I'll coordinate scheduling for the hardware replacement with netops.
liam (eng-runtime): Saving dump of failed pods: `/var/log/serving/oom-dumps/1769004321.tar.gz` and linking to incident doc.
maria (postmortem): I'll collect logs and assign action owners. Drafting incident summary now.
ellie (cs): Will follow up with ACME and SearchCo once postmortem is ready.
mel (sre): Closing slack thread for active paging; will reopen if netops flags recurrence. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
